$comment: Free multi-valued labels on exercises. Unlike discipline/category/movementPattern -- each of which is single-valued and structural -- tags are additive and exist to power search and automatic substitution. An exercise may carry none.

items.label: Unilateral
items.use: One limb at a time; surfaces imbalances and halves the load needed.

items.label: Isometric
items.use: Held rather than moved. Pairs with the `hold` logging mode.

items.label: Explosive
items.use: Intent is speed. Keep volume low and place it early in a session.

items.label: Skill
items.use: Needs practice as much as strength. Program it fresh, not to failure.

items.label: Compound
items.use: Crosses more than one joint; the main drivers of a session.

items.label: Low impact
items.use: No jumping or landing. Safe default for joint limitations.

items.label: No equipment
items.use: Needs nothing at all -- the true home-workout filter.

items.label: Core stability
items.use: Resists movement of the spine rather than producing it.

items.label: Grip intensive
items.use: Grip fails before the target muscle; watch it in pulling blocks.

items.label: Rehab friendly
items.use: Commonly tolerated in return-to-training work. Not a clinical clearance.

items.label: Warm-up
items.use: Prepares tissue and pattern before the working sets.

items.label: Finisher
items.use: Ends a session; high fatigue, low technical demand.
